newsitem.title: USA: Novartis Seeds forms pact with Hoffman Seeds.
newsitem.headline: Novartis Seeds forms pact with Hoffman Seeds.

text.p: Novartis Seeds Inc said Monday it had agreed to make Hoffman Seeds Inc of Landisville, Pa., the exclusive distributor, producer and marketer of Novartis Seeds products in 13 Northeastern states.
Pending the outcome of negotiations, the exclusive contract will take effect July 1, 1997.
The agreement will give Hoffman Seeds exclusive rights to produce, market and sell all Novartis Seeds NK Brand corn, soybeans, alfalfa, and grain and forage sorghum.

Hoffman Seeds, founded in 1899, established its first exclusive agreement with Funk Bros. Seed Co in Bloomington, Ill., in the 1930s. Hoffman's agreement continued after the 1974 purchase of Funk Bros. by Ciba-Geigy AG.

Novartis seeds was formed by the January 1, 1997, merger of Ciba Seeds and Northrup King Co. The company is an affiliate of Novartis Seeds AG, a Swiss-based research organization that produces and sells corn, soybean, alfalfa, sunflower, sorghum, sugar beet, vegetable and flower seeds.
